richest.equity_flag: The socio-economic disparities and cultural practices in  the South-Western part of Nigeria may contribute to higher rates of  adolescent pregnancy, which can exacerbate malnutrition issues and wasting  among adolescents. Improved sanitation is a crucial factor in this  context.
richest.beyond_poverty: Nutritional habits and dietary choices may be  influencing the high prevalence of anaemia in South East compared to other  zones.
richest.structural_recommendation: Targeted health education programs focused  on improving nutrition, sanitation and access to clean water sources  should be implemented in higher burden zones such as NC and NE.  Additionally, policies aimed at reducing adolescent pregnancy prevalence  in SW zone could also help mitigate the impact of the pathway.
